designDecisions: Shade strength is physically bounded between 0 and 1.
Training may use latent target values above 1 as evidence that a site requires full Google-direct shading.
Runtime output never extrapolates beyond the Google-direct shade profile.
Installer shade is benchmark-only and is not a live model input.
Installer production is benchmark-only and is used only for validation.
Candidate v2 is not approved for live Zeyzer use yet.
knownLimitations: Benchmark-002 remains influential and relatively difficult to predict when held out.
Heavy-shade sites show significant monthly timing/profile error even when annual shade magnitude is accurate.
A new independent benchmark is required before final production approval.
